title: Mecha-nudges for Machines
abstract: arXiv:2603.23433v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI agents are becoming active decision-makers on the Internet. As they make decisions in the same environments as humans, the environments themselves can change to influence them. We call this $\textit{mecha-nudging}$: changes to how choices are presented that systematically influence AI agents without materially degrading the decision environment for humans. To measure this phenomenon, we combine two frameworks---Bayesian persuasion from economics and $\mathcal{V}$-usable information from computer science---to get a common unit (bits) for quantifying how environments change across a wide range of interventions, contexts, and models. We apply this framework to over six million Etsy listings and find that, after ChatGPT's release, listings contain significantly more machine-usable information for predicting agent curation decisions, increasing by 0.143 bits out of a maximum possible increase of 0.355. translated_title: 面向机器的机械式助推
translated_abstract: AI智能体正在成为互联网上活跃的决策者。由于它们在与人类相同的环境中做出决策，环境本身可以发生变化来影响它们。我们将这种现象称为“机械式助推”：即通过改变选项的呈现方式来系统性地影响AI智能体，同时不会实质性降低人类的决策环境质量。为了测量这一现象，我们结合了两个框架——经济学中的贝叶斯说服和计算机科学中的V-可用信息——从而获得一个通用单位（比特），用于量化在各种干预、情境和模型下环境的变化。我们将该框架应用于超过600万条Etsy商品列表，发现自ChatGPT发布之后，商品列表中包含显著更多的可用于预测智能体筛选决策的机器可用信息，增加了0.143比特（最大可能增量为0.355比特）。这一转变在各种提示下均表现出稳健性。
tldr: 本文提出“机械式助推”概念，结合经济学中的贝叶斯说服与计算机科学中的V-可用信息框架，以比特为单位量化环境对AI智能体决策的影响，并发现ChatGPT发布后Etsy商品列表中面向机器的可用信息量显著增加0.143比特。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "mecha-nudging" by combining Bayesian persuasion and V-usable information to quantify in bits how environments systematically influence AI agents, finding that Etsy listings significantly increased machine-usable information by 0.143 bits after ChatGPT's release.
